official: Revisions to Drinking Water Code for Thurston County Article III
stake: Revisions to Sanitary Code Article III governing Group B private and shared residential drinking water wells.
text: Health Board weighs updates to county drinking water code Updated Oct 13, 2026 • Matter ID: Sanitary Code Article III Official Title : BOH Public Hearing: Revisions to Drinking Water Code for Thurston County Article III Docket : Thurston County • Today 2026 10 13 Stage : Hearing For Staff Regulatory Baseline Discrepancy Staff Report, Section 2 vs WAC 246 291 : County draft proposals adjust local testing intervals for Group B systems, but packet documents do not cite whether state Department of Health concurrence was obtained under WAC 246 291 030. Why This Matters Now The Thurston County Board of Health is holding a public hearing to consider formal amendments to the county sanitary code. This hearing directly affects private well owners, rural homeowners, and shared residential water systems across unincorporated Thurston County. The revisions update testing intervals, wellhead protection standards, and hydrogeological review rules under Article III of the Sanitary Code. While county health rules must conform to state Department of Health baselines WAC 246 291 , the Board of Health exercises local legislative choice over county testing intervals and local permit fees.
